title: Algebra Vocabulary
shortDescription: Fill in the blanks using the word bank to practise key algebra vocabulary.
intro: Tap a word from the box, then tap the blank where it belongs. Tap a filled blank to clear it.
seoDescription: Free interactive Grade 8 Maths worksheet on algebra vocabulary. Fill in the blanks from a word bank and get an instant score.

questions.prompt: Choose words from the box and fill in the blanks.

blanks.text: A letter such as x that represents an unknown number is called a _____.
In 7x, the number 7 is called the _____.
A number on its own, with no variable attached, is a _____.
A statement that two expressions are equal, using an equals sign, is an _____.
Each separate part of an expression, separated by + or -, is a _____.
